run_apply_pca: run the script to transform wav2vec features via PCA and save to a target directory
run_apply_pca_unfiltered: run the PCA transformation script on unfiltered wav2vec features with the --unfiltered flag
run_apply_pca_custom_batch: run the PCA feature transformation with a custom batch size for memory control
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that defines CLI arguments for PCA feature transformation
review_main: review the main function that loads features, applies PCA transform, and saves results in batches
